verdict.rationale: The documented job-creation endpoint has an explicit direct-upload option for local media, with a published 2 GiB limit (also stated as up to 24 hours of audio). A types page says both audio-only files and video files with audio tracks are accepted, and an OpenAPI spec is served at a public URL. missing for 10: an explicit published list of accepted file formats or codecs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that local file upload works.
